requirement.english_reference: Installation of electrical wiring and safety equipment without ratings or specifications
requirement.canonical_translation: Installation of electrical wiring and safety devices

classification.rationale: Requirement specifies the physical execution and installation of electrical wiring circuits and safety devices rather than procurement of a single manufactured product component.

original_ground_truth.original_notes: Vague Tamil requirement, safe abstention required
original_ground_truth.defect_analysis: The original benchmark conflated product procurement ambiguity with installation execution standards. When no individual wire/switch rating was isolated, it defaulted to abstention (null), failing to recognize that installation execution is directly governed by national installation codes of practice.

authoritative_evidence.full_title: Code of Practice for Electrical Wiring Installations (Fourth Revision)
authoritative_evidence.scope: Applies to non-industrial and industrial electrical installations in buildings. Covers design, selection, erection, verification, and inspection of electrical wiring installations and associated safety equipment up to 1000 V AC.
normative_clauses: Clause 1: Scope of electrical wiring installations in buildings
Clause 4: Protection for safety (shock, thermal, overcurrent)
Clause 5: Selection and erection of wiring systems and safety equipment
Clause 6: Verification, inspection, and initial/periodic testing
regulatory_and_procurement_mandate: Bureau of Indian Standards (BIS) ETD 20 Official Catalogue
CPWD General Specifications for Electrical Works (Part I Internal) Section 1.2 mandating compliance with IS 732 for all building internal wiring and safety installations
Central Electricity Authority (Measures relating to Safety and Electric Supply) Regulations

dependency_and_earthing_assessment.relationship: IS 732 Clause 5 normative references cite IS 3043:2018 (Code of Practice for Earthing) for earthing conductor sizing and electrode pit execution. IS 732 remains the primary overarching standard governing the complete wiring installation.

formal_adjudication.adjudication_reason: The original benchmark treated the absence of a single product specification as requiring abstention. Independent technical review shows that this requirement is an installation/code-of-practice requirement for which IS 732:2019 ('Code of practice for electrical wiring installations') is directly applicable. Therefore the original null label is technically over-abstention and is corrected to IS 732:2019.
